verdict.rationale: The pack never states who bears fraud, liability, or chargeback risk for agent-initiated transactions. The closest items are operational: dispute and refund tools (list_disputes, accept_dispute_claim, create_refund) and delegated single-use tokens bound to the merchant ID with amount and time limits. Neither documents liability allocation, chargeback rules, or seller-protection terms for the agentic channel, so this applicable axis is unevidenced.
